final: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100) * 1.0 / COUNT(c.client_id) FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp AS p ON p.client_id = c.client_id AND p.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
